extra.notes: Input was rotated 1 CCW quarter by degrade_scan, plus skew. Expected auto_rotate quarters is 3. Residual = (1 + auto_rotate) % 4; 0 is upright relative to the clean render, 1 or 3 is sideways, 2 is upside down. The failing upright-page tests at cecec57 returned 1 when 0 was expected (over-rotate by one CCW quarter).
